name: menthol + peppermint oil + pine needle oil (pinus mugo)
purpose: Co Cool is an essence oil that is the main ingredient of the herb extract of nature. If you put it in your nose when you feel stuffy, your nose feels cool and your head clear.
uses: Apply it on the inside of the nose and under the nose as often as necessary, and gently rub the nose.
otcwarn: ■ don’t use on the part where there is injury, eczema, or dermatitis ■ if swallowed, get medical help or contact a person control center immediately
